messages.content: What's the population in New York right now?

function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: I don’t have real‑time census data, but the most recent estimates put New York City’s population at roughly **8.5 million** residents (as of 2023). The figure is an approximation and can vary slightly depending on the source and the exact date.
message.reasoning: We need to answer question about current population in New York. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have up-to-date info. But maybe we can use a known estimate: as of 2023, New York City population ~8.5 million. But "right now" might refer to current year. We can provide approximate. Also mention that it's an estimate. No function needed.
